feature: One central dedicated YouTube session for admin downloads
activation: Not active: private account label is prepared; no real YouTube cookies have been supplied.

storage.permissions: Gateway identity has access plus a secret-scoped custom role containing only versions.add and versions.disable.

access.use: Only owner/pricing-admin downloads of YouTube links receive the shared session. Ordinary users never receive it even when downloads are globally enabled.
access.readback: Admin returns configured/expired state, account label and saved timestamp only.

safeguards: Netscape cookie format and YouTube-only domains validated before storage; client also rejects other website cookies before transmission.
Session values never stored in job/account records or included in logs.
Temporary cookie file mode 0600, removed after the download step succeeds or fails.
Each reconnect/disconnect replaces the latest secret version and disables its predecessor.
Global management lease serializes credential updates.
Disconnect stops future uses, not the Google account session itself.

validation.actual_signed_in_download: Pending user sign-in/session export; not claimed verified.
